purpose: Falsify deterministic exchange-calendar, institutional-date, and disclosure-seasonality policies for pre-open open-to-close ranking. These are conditional historical policies and hierarchical posteriors, not dummy additions or tuning of a price Ridge model.

point_in_time.training_rule: Every return used in a calendar cell, issuer posterior, event-family posterior, release-clock cell, density threshold, or score has date strictly earlier than the first scored session of its month.
point_in_time.calendar_source: The frozen JPX panel session index only. Weekday, calendar gaps, month position, quarter month, reporting window and SQ proxy are deterministic functions of dates and the session index; outcome results cannot alter them.
point_in_time.price_training_filter: price_training_eligible true and open-to-close return observed
point_in_time.tdnet_fail_closed: TDnet-dependent policies may train and score only sessions for which every calendar-day index from the preceding panel session through the target session exists in the frozen caches. Missing pages mean unknown, never no disclosure.
point_in_time.source_rule: candidate_price_source_max_date is null or strictly before row date; mapped disclosure timestamp is no later than 08:58:59 on row date
point_in_time.target_mutation_test: For each score month replace scoring return and label values, rerun all twelve scorers and selections, and require exact scores, masks, and selected keys.

deterministic_calendar_definitions.weekday: Monday=0 through Friday=4 from the target session date
deterministic_calendar_definitions.post_holiday: Target session minus preceding panel session is at least three calendar days
deterministic_calendar_definitions.pre_holiday: Following panel session minus target is at least three calendar days; last panel session has state unknown and is ineligible
deterministic_calendar_definitions.month_start: First three panel sessions in calendar month
deterministic_calendar_definitions.month_end: Last three panel sessions in a completed calendar month
deterministic_calendar_definitions.turn_of_month: Last two sessions of a completed calendar month or first three sessions of a calendar month
deterministic_calendar_definitions.quarter_end: Last five sessions of March, June, September or December
deterministic_calendar_definitions.fiscal_half_or_year_end: Last five sessions of March or September
deterministic_calendar_definitions.sq_proxy: Second Friday of the calendar month; if it is not a panel session, use the most recent panel session in the same Monday-Friday week
deterministic_calendar_definitions.earnings_season: Last five sessions of January, April, July or October, plus first ten sessions of February, May, August or November
deterministic_calendar_definitions.release_clock: Latest qualifying bundle document: same-day premarket; prior-session close through 16:29; 16:30 through 19:59; or 20:00 and later/weekend/older
deterministic_calendar_definitions.high_disclosure_density: Current strict session bundle count is at least the 75th percentile of strictly prior strict-session bundle counts; quantile method higher

hierarchical_lock.global_prior: Strictly prior cross-sectional cell mean; zero if the cell has no prior observations

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: On every session, rank all price-eligible names by issuer-by-weekday clipped-return mean shrunk with twenty observations toward the prior global weekday mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Persistent issuer-specific inventory or flow patterns recur on a given weekday.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only deterministic post-holiday sessions and rank by issuer post-holiday mean shrunk toward the prior global post-holiday mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Multi-day information accumulation creates issuer-specific continuation or reversal at the next open-to-close session.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only deterministic pre-holiday sessions and rank by issuer pre-holiday mean shrunk toward the prior global pre-holiday mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Position reduction before long closures creates stable issuer-level intraday effects.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only the first three sessions of each month and rank by issuer month-start posterior mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Periodic allocation and contribution flows recur at month opening.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only the final three sessions of completed months and rank by issuer month-end posterior mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Benchmarking, window dressing and rebalancing create issuer-specific month-end pressure.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: On last-two/first-three turn sessions, estimate each issuer's turn-of-month mean minus its non-turn mean, shrink the differential with thirty observations, and add the prior global turn mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: A differential self-control removes persistent issuer return level and isolates turn-specific flow.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only the final five sessions of quarter-ending months and rank by issuer quarter-end posterior mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Quarterly benchmark and balance-sheet activity creates a distinct issuer ranking.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only the final five sessions of March or September and rank by issuer fiscal-half/year-end posterior mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Japanese fiscal reporting and institutional book-closing flows differ from generic quarter-end effects.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only the deterministic second-Friday SQ proxy and rank by issuer SQ-session posterior mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Index derivative settlement and hedging create repeatable issuer-level open-to-close pressure.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: During fixed reporting windows, rank only observed pre-open TDnet bundles. Estimate primary-family return, then add an issuer-family deviation shrunk with twenty observations; family cells require thirty prior rows.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: The same disclosure family is interpreted differently during scheduled reporting congestion than outside it.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: Rank only observed bundles by primary-family-by-fixed-release-clock posterior mean shrunk with fifty observations toward the family mean; cells require thirty prior rows.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Managerial release timing and investor processing time jointly change the intraday payoff distribution.

registered_hypotheses.mechanism: On strict sessions whose known bundle count exceeds the locked expanding 75th-percentile density state, rank observed bundles by family-in-high-density posterior mean shrunk toward the overall family mean.
registered_hypotheses.prediction: Attention congestion changes which disclosure families retain unabsorbed value after the open.

portfolio.cash_rule: Execute a slot only when its posterior expected gross return is strictly greater than +0.40%. Empty or ineligible slots remain cash with fixed weight 1/capacity; do not renormalise.
portfolio.scheduled_day_denominator: All 266 score-period panel sessions, including full-cash days and fail-closed TDnet days

reported: monthly net40 and three locked temporal slices
slots, traded days, cash days, unique codes
largest and top-ten code weight share
top-ten positive-P&L codes replaced by cash
evaluation.multiplicity: 5000 deterministic circular moving-block resamples, block length ten sessions; studentised one-sided familywise max-t lower bounds and White-style reality-check adjusted p-values against cash across all twenty-four policies.
evaluation.selection_rule: Freeze the highest net40 candidate only if every retrospective gate passes. If none passes, freeze no finalist.

production_gate.failure_action: Reject the full calendar family and preregister a structurally different mechanism; never redefine calendar windows from observed returns.

prior_research_scope_warning.statement: Japanese calendar-effect evidence is old, mixed and largely index/close-to-close based. It cannot be transferred unconditionally to individual-stock open-to-close ranking.
